selection_reason: Real handwritten inputs, official writer-disjoint train/test, compact fixed-weight matrix operations, tractable converter-to-task attribution.

dataset.normalization: Fixed division by 16; no fitted test statistics
dataset.calibration_split: Per-class seeded permutation of official training rows; first floor(20%) calibration, remainder training
dataset.test_policy: Official test remains untouched by training, calibration and model selection. No test metric until model and hardware profile are frozen.

model.model_selection: Fixed final epoch; no hyperparameter search in this version

placement.memory_technology: unresolved; resistive-crossbar simulation is an assumption until a device/prototype is selected

acceptance.origin: Engineering targets declared before this experiment; not customer requirements
acceptance.uncertainty: Report paired 95% bootstrap interval for accuracy difference; do not claim noninferiority unless its lower bound exceeds -0.01
acceptance.hardware_measurements: Same model/data, instrumented rails, synchronized task traces; include conversion, movement, calibration and fallback costs
open_requirements: absolute latency/thermal limits for a selected device

claim_boundary: Real-data software demonstrator preparation only. Converter, physical array, firmware, board, energy advantage and customer readiness remain unproven.
